claims.text: The trip record and the GPS trace describe the same trip: both carry trip_id TRP-02828, the trace's first fix at 2026-09-03T08:08:20+08:00 matches the trip_record's trip_started event at 2026-09-03T08:08:20+08:00, and the trace's last fix at 2026-09-03T08:27:10+08:00 matches the trip_completed event. The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is therefore discharged on matching identifiers and timestamps.

The trace measures 14.4 km against a booked optimal of 9.0 km, an excess of 5.4 km. That is 60.0% of optimal, above the 20% establishment threshold, and 5.4 km absolute, above the 0.8 km establishment threshold, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01. It is also above the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates, so it is a MATERIAL deviation requiring the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check.

The governing distance figure is the trace, not the trip record: POL-RD-01 provides that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree, the trace governs and the trip_record figure may not be cited for the threshold test. Here both read 14.4 km, so the threshold test is safe either way, but the trace figure is the one that carries it.

The driver's only explanation is 'Road works.' in the counterparty statement. That is an assertion of an external traffic cause, and under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle holds no advisory covering this trip window: EV-ADVIS-02828-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and its issue detail records that no advisory covers the Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 is therefore unavailable, the comparison cannot be run, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

The driver's traffic assertion cites no evidence ID for any advisory, so under POL-RD-13(1) the missing advisory is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5): an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one. The absence of an advisory no party has cited is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and it does not escalate the case.

The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): it carries 114 fixes at a 10 second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, with no straight-line jump over 500 m. The rider's excess is therefore measured from an unimpaired trace, and POL-RD-13(2) applies: the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

No rider-requested detour can be run on this record. The chat log carries zero messages, so there is no rider instruction meeting POL-RD-04(a) to (c), and no waypoint_hint exists to corroborate. POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no distance is excluded from the excess on that ground.

No pickup or dropoff relocation can be run either: trip_record.pickup_amended_at and trip_record.dropoff_amended_at are both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null. POL-RD-05 does not apply and the booked optimal of 9.0 km stands as the baseline.

The trip is not a pooled trip: trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. POL-RD-12 does not apply and the matched-itinerary baseline it would substitute is not in play.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not. The recomputation is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 9.0 + 0.28 x 13.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 14.99. Charged_total is 20.66, so the refund is 20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, which rounds up to SGD 5.70 payable. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

The surge multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, which is 1.0, and not from the trip_record, which does not carry the field. The recomputation above therefore carries no surge uplift, and the refund is not doubled by reading surge as absent.

No ERP or toll line needs separate treatment: the fare_breakdown carries zero ERP gantries and a tolls_erp of 0.00, and the optimal route ERP is 0.00. There is no off-route gantry to refund as a standalone pass-through correction under POL-RD-09, and no phantom line to correct.

The driver_profile check under POL-RD-06 is required because the deviation is MATERIAL. On the citable fields, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2 and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 180, giving a ratio of 0.011, below the 0.05 gate, and the flag count is below the 3 gate. No repeat-deviation pattern is established on the fields POL-RD-06 names, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follow from this trip.

The rider's own profile does not trigger the POL-RD-08 corroboration gate: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the 4-claim threshold, so no additional corroboration beyond the gps_trace is required for this claim. The rider's other profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01 and are not relied on.

The rider's claim is supported by artifacts other than the gps_trace: the trip_record records the 9.0 km optimal and the 14.4 km actual, and the fare_breakdown records the 20.66 charged against a 14.99 recomputed fare. The claim is not a bare trace assertion.
The monetary effect of this ruling is SGD 5.70, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund is executed automatically on issue subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both parties.

AGREED FACTS. The platform instruments for trip TRP-02828 are consistent and unimpaired. The governing distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 14.4 km (EV-GPS-02828), which is the figure POL-RD-01 requires us to use and which agrees with trip_record.actual_distance_km (EV-TRIP-02828). The booked optimal is 9.0 km, so the excess is 5.4 km. That excess is 60.0% of the optimal distance (above the 20% establishment test) and 5.4 km in absolute terms (above the 0.8 km test): both limbs pass, so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01. It is also above the 50% materiality gate, so it is a MATERIAL deviation.

GPS INTEGRITY. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 114 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, no straight-line jump over 500 m. No escalation under POL-RD-10(3) arises, and no independent corroboration is required.

DRIVER'S TRAFFIC ASSERTION. The driver's explanation was 'Road works' (counterparty statement, 2026-09-03). An external traffic cause is tested by POL-RD-13 against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle holds no advisory covering this trip window: EV-ADVIS-02828-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and the detail 'No advisory covers the Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 corridor in this window.' POL-RD-03 is therefore unavailable, the comparison cannot be run, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver named no evidence ID for any advisory, so under POL-RD-13(1) this is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation trigger. The assertion is discarded and no advisory was on file; the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

DRIVER PROFILE (POL-RD-06). Required because the deviation is material. On the only citable fields, deviation_flags_90d = 2 (below the 3-flag gate) and completed_trips_90d = 180, giving 2/180 = 0.011 (below the 0.05 gate with 180 ≥ 40). No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral.

REFUND (POL-RD-02). The fare model is METERED (EV-FARE-02828), so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 9.0 + 0.28 × 13.0) × surge 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 14.99. The surge multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (EV-FARE-02828), which is 1.0; the trip_record does not carry the field. charged_total = 20.66, so refund = 20.66 − 14.99 = 5.67, rounded UP to SGD 5.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 27.4% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70. Charged_total 20.66, recomputed_fare 14.99 and refund 5.70 are stated on separate lines.

PASS-THROUGH (POL-RD-09). Zero ERP gantries and zero tolls; the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. No standalone pass-through correction and no billing-integrity finding arise.

OTHER CLAUSES. POL-RD-04 cannot run: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02828) contains zero messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint. POL-RD-05 cannot run: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null. POL-RD-12 does not apply: vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the matched-itinerary baseline is not in play and the booked optimal of 9.0 km stands.

CONFIDENCE. The deciding fact — the excess distance — is carried by the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02828) and the trip record (EV-TRIP-02828), both at weight_multiplier 1.0 (and by the fare breakdown at 1.0). No deciding fact is carried by an impaired artifact, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, and confidence is set at 0.95.

EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect, SGD 5.70, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund executes automatically on issue. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
